text: That thin crack on your terrace looks harmless in summer.
In the monsoon, water finds it.
It seeps in, reaches the slab, and can show up as damp patches on the ceiling below.
Over time, moisture can reach the steel inside, and that is when repairs get bigger.
So check it now, while it is dry.
Walk the terrace. Look near the parapet walls, around pipes, and where water stands after rain.
Mark every crack with chalk, and take a photo.
Then show your engineer before the rains, and ask which ones need sealing, and which need a closer look.
Save this for your pre-monsoon check.
